company_name: California Governor’s Office of Business and Economic Development

summary: The California Governor’s Office of Business and Economic Development (GO-Biz) promotes job growth and economic development, specifically targeting the semiconductor sector. They lead initiatives to attract semiconductor investments and support regional partners in enhancing California's position in the global semiconductor landscape.
